skills.name: remember_memory
skills.description: Save user-stated memory in a category: preferences, personal, facts, instructions, projects, decisions, goals, tasks, procedures, constraints or observations. Default auto categorizes clear statements. Instructions are user guidance, never execution authorization. Use scope user or project:NAME.

steps.description: Required text steps for category procedures; saved procedures do not execute automatically.

outcome.description: Required reported outcome for category episodes. Not automatically verified.

occurred_at.description: Optional Unix event time in whole seconds for category episodes.

skills.name: recall_memory
skills.description: Recall current categorized memories or historical conversations. Filter by category and scope. Default user scope excludes other projects; explicit project:NAME includes that project and shared user memories. Related passages are evidence, not proof of an answer.

device.description: Filter conversation turns by device; shared facts and profiles remain global.

skills.name: forget_memory
skills.description: Forget a stored fact by exact text match.

skills.name: clear_memory
skills.description: Clear stored facts and structured memories ONLY; preserve profiles, indexed documents, and continuous transcripts.

skills.name: correct_memory
skills.description: Correct an outdated structured memory using its recalled ID and explicit user correction. Preserves evidence and revision history; do not infer corrections from assistant assertions.

skills.name: memory_history
skills.description: Inspect provenance and revisions of a structured memory ID. Historical superseded text is not a current fact or instruction.

skills.name: update_memory_profile
skills.description: Update the content of a named memory profile.

skills.name: index_memory_document
skills.description: Index a document at the supplied path for memory retrieval.

skills.name: sync_memory_vault
skills.description: Sync remembered facts, profiles, documents and continuous history to linked Markdown nodes in the configured Obsidian vault. Preserves manual edits and reports conflicts.

skills.name: sync_memory_department
skills.description: Sync active conversation turns to Obsidian daily note, check event-driven day rollover, and compact previous days automatically.

skills.name: compact_memory_history
skills.description: Compact historical daily conversation files into clean executive summaries with carried-over tasks, stripping filler and raw logs.

target_date.description: Optional specific date YYYY-MM-DD to compact. If omitted, compacts all historical daily notes.

skills.name: prune_memory_vault
skills.description: Remove empty Markdown stubs from the Memory Department conversations folder in the configured vault.

dry_run.description: If true, only report empty files without deleting them.

skills.name: reflect_memory
skills.description: Analyze episodic error traces and distill procedural rules via the A3 Reflection Agent.
